_comment: Operator-approved scope baseline for the DataPhase2 `alternative` collector.
This is a DECLARATION, not a produced artifact: it records a human ruling about
what the collector's scope is allowed to be, and it is compared against a scope
the run DERIVES from constituents.json at collection time. Per overseer-policy
invariant 18, the bound stays declared and the measurement stays derived.
It lives in the repo rather than in S3 so that (a) the merge button alone deploys
it -- a hand-written S3 object would be the post-merge operator step
pull-request-policy.md 4.2 forbids, and nothing about it fails when it never runs
-- and (b) changing the approved scope shows up in a diff with its ruling
attached, which is the whole provenance question a bucket cannot answer.
Ruling: Brian, 2026-07-31 on alpha-engine-config-I5814 -- DataPhase2 collects
alternative data for the WHOLE universe (~903) rather than the pre-2026-07-21
decision set (~27), and moves to the spot substrate. Comparison is +/- the
collector's _SCOPE_CHANGE_TOLERANCE, so ordinary constituent churn passes and
another unintended 33x scope change still fails loudly.
To change the approved scope: open a PR editing this file, cite the ruling that
authorises it, and say why. Do not widen _SCOPE_CHANGE_TOLERANCE to make a real
step change fit -- that disarms the guard for every future change too.
